experiment: 任务09：低置信度时额外保留一个片段

definitions_zh.scope: 合并或模式|预算。相同留出任务在六个模式与预算组合中重复。
definitions_zh.cached_cost: 每条轨迹内部累计缓存成本，再按轨迹平均，单位为等价基础输入 token。
definitions_zh.occupancy: 每条轨迹末步保留 token 除以有效预算，再按轨迹平均。
definitions_zh.hedge_rate: 执行了额外加段的步数 / 全部步数。未使用加段器的历史基线记为 null。
definitions_zh.hedge_hit_rate: 额外片段属于当前可用金标的步数 / 执行加段的步数。分母为零时 rate 为 null。
definitions_zh.mean_added_per_step: 全部动作步内平均新增的不同片段数。无效动作保持原状，新增数为零。
definitions_zh.current_gold_miss_rate: 当前金标在本步新候选中且此前未保留，但执行后仍未保留的比例，以有资格的步数为分母。
definitions_zh.raw_diff: 同一任务、模式、预算和步号对齐后，模型提示和完整输入状态均一致的步中原始贪心输出不同的数量。

score_checks.method: On each actual native vLLM greedy forward pass, a worker observer reads the pre-constraint logits and computes the selected logit minus float64 logsumexp. The production scorer uses these independently computed probabilities throughout the common token prefix of every candidate and teacher forces each divergent branch. vLLM sampler generation.logprobs independently supplies the reference (float32 log_softmax). No native generation logprobs are read to score the shared prefix. Every entire candidate is reconstructed from its raw prefix and branch observations. Previously attempted independently scheduled BF16 forwards remain in the prior receipts.

train.selection: highest pooled mean step reward; ties choose smaller tau

metrics.hedge_hit: extra is any previously revealed or current gold
metrics.current_gold_miss: current gold newly available but absent after the executed action, conditional on newly available
metrics.mean_extra_tokens: tokens added to greedy's keep_after, averaged over all states
metrics.score_ties: equal log scores retain prompt candidate order
